state_background_check.value: No — Tennessee's eligibility statute (Tenn. Code Ann. § 8-18-101) applies only to persons "qualified to hold office under the authority of this state" by its own text, not federal office; separately, the U.S. Constitution's own qualifications for Congress (age, citizenship, residency) can't be added to by any state, so this doesn't reach U.S. House or Senate candidates either way
state_background_check.snippet: Tenn. Code Ann. § 8-18-101: "All persons eighteen (18) years of age or older who are citizens of the United States and of this state... are qualified to hold office under the authority of this state except: (1) Those who have been convicted of offering or giving a bribe, or any other offense declared infamous under § 40-20-112..." Congressional qualifications are set exclusively by the U.S. Constitution, confirmed per https://www.everycrsreport.com/reports/R41946.html: "the Framers intended the Constitution to be the exclusive source of qualifications for Members of Congress, and that the Framers thereby 'divested' States of any power to add qualifications."

bio_summary.value: Tim Burchett is a lifelong East Tennessee conservative, a husband, a dad, and the Republican Congressman for Congress in Tennessee’s 2nd Congressional District. He ran for Congress because he was fed up with the status quo in our nation’s Capitol. Born in Knoxville, Tennessee, Tim attended Bearden High School before earning his Bachelor’s degree in education from the University of Tennessee. Dedicated to serving his community, Tim has spent much of his adult life serving the people of East Tennessee.

platform.value: We need better paths to citizenship while showing compassion to those seeking the legal route. Border enforcement must be prepared to defend against smugglers, yet ready to help those seeking a chance to pursue their American Dream.
platform.snippet: We are a nation of immigrants, but sovereign nations must have secure borders. We need better paths to citizenship while showing compassion to those seeking the legal route. Our border enforcement must be prepared to defend against smugglers, yet ready to help those seeking a chance to pursue their American Dream.

platform.value: Super PACs must be abolished. Lobbyists should not have more influence over our leaders than the people who elected them. Will aggressively pursue destruction of Citizens United.
platform.snippet: Corporations are not people. Super PACs must be abolished. Lobbyists should not have more influence over our leaders than the people who elected them in the first place. Adam despises the black hole that is Citizens United and will aggressively pursue its destruction.

platform.value: Addressing the massive rise in cost of home ownership that is now out of reach for many, which has been caused by corporate greed and failed policies that hold back the working class.
platform.snippet: Our district has fallen victim to the massive rise in cost of home ownership. For many of us, it is now out of reach. Our American Dream has been stolen by corporate greed and failed polices that hold back the working class.

platform.value: Americans deserve clean water, air, and soil. Must act now to protect national parks and public lands from being sold off to corporations.
platform.snippet: Americans deserve clean water, air, and soil. Our national parks and public lands are in danger of being sold off to corporations. History has shown us how human hubris can destroy swaths of land and kill the life it supports. We must act now before it is too late.

platform.value: Cannot continue failed economic policies and increase debts to subsidize billion dollar corporations.
platform.snippet: We are the wealthiest nation on Earth, yet our debt continues to put us at risk of economic collapse. We cannot continue failed economic policies and increase our debts to subsidize billion dollar corporations.

platform.value: A healthy workforce creates a better economy and better opportunities for children to pursue.
platform.snippet: Working class Americans are the blood of this nation. When they are able to thrive, so does our community and the families that call them home. A healthy workforce creates a better economy. A better economy creates better opportunities for our children to pursue.

bio_summary.value: Adam Lee Heimerman is a 7th generation East Tennessean and has always been passionate about his home. He grew up understanding the value of hard work, the importance of reliability, and the strength of Appalachian resilience. He spent ten years working with the river guiding community across our nation and spent more time outdoors than in. Adam is the type of man who chose morals over money, and experiences over material wealth. He does not desire a career in politics nor personal enrichment, and that is what we need most in these trying times, a man with integrity.
